reply_text:
I answered Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 put Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her two related facts for the QBR deck:
- 185 is still the active seat count.
- Amendment No. 3, signed on 2026-09-22, raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.

The figures come from the amendment text and the account page in the knowledge brain. Dana is the account owner, and seat counts and dates count as operational facts rather than finance figures, so no approval was needed. The reply has no prices or other money terms.
